experiments.name: A6a initial 409
experiments.result: Question-only selection 54.3% versus blunt projection 44.7%; +9.5pp, cluster 95% CI +5.4 to +13.7, McNemar p=1.3e-5.
experiments.decision: License the paired selection claim; absolute accuracies are lower bounds because the shared time assumption was omitted from both prompts.

economics.notes: Packet payload was 36.7M versus 64.0M characters; historical token receipts were not consolidated in the committed result.

experiments.name: A6a run 2
experiments.result: Question-only selection 54.5% versus blunt projection 46.2%; +8.3pp, cluster 95% CI +3.8 to +12.9, McNemar p=0.000183.
experiments.decision: The selection result survives the repaired time-assumption prompt and pinned model runtime.

economics.notes: Across both arms. Selection used 26,207,434 accepted tokens versus 40,610,756 for blunt projection; all-attempt totals were 26,668,834 versus 40,966,205.

experiments.name: QT-1 include pinning
experiments.result: Include pinning 54.0% versus A6a 53.8%; +0.24pp, cluster 95% CI -1.44 to +1.99, McNemar p=1.0.
experiments.decision: Preserving referenced resources alone did not improve correctness.

economics.notes: A6a comparator accepted 26,207,434 tokens in run 2.

experiments.name: QT-2 aggregate summary
experiments.result: Aggregate summary 54.5% versus A6a 54.8%; -0.24pp, cluster 95% CI -2.36 to +2.06, McNemar p=1.0.
experiments.decision: Summaries reduced abstention but did not reduce errors, so the feature was not promoted.

economics.notes: A6a comparator accepted 26,207,434 tokens in run 2.

experiments.name: QT-3 endpoint reserve
experiments.result: Endpoint reserve tied A6a at 54.8%; 0.0pp, cluster 95% CI -1.44 to +1.37, McNemar p=1.0.
experiments.decision: Endpoint reservation alone was null and was not promoted.

economics.notes: A6a comparator accepted 26,207,434 tokens in run 2; one non-JSON warning line was ignored when summing complete usage receipts.

experiments.name: Exploratory model/effort grid
experiments.population: 99 questions per cell / six model-effort cells
experiments.result: Archived aggregates are internally inconsistent: every cell records 99 answered items but uses n=409 as the accuracy denominator.
experiments.decision: Exclude the grid from every generality claim until it is deterministically regraded with the registered 99-question denominator.

economics.notes: Not consolidated because the analysis denominator is invalid.

experiments.name: QT-4 micro42 mechanism screen
experiments.result: Vocabulary versus A6a +42.9pp (95% CI +20.5 to +63.6); traversal versus vocabulary +7.1pp (95% CI 0 to +15.9).
experiments.decision: Advance vocabulary to untouched confirmation; do not promote traversal from the same-set screen.

economics.notes: Three answer arms; zero failed attempts. Panel usage is not included in this subtotal.

experiments.name: QT-4 valid374 holdout
experiments.result: Vocabulary versus A6a on dispatched questions +34.1pp (95% CI +17.9 to +50.0); traversal versus vocabulary +9.1pp (95% CI 0 to +20.9).
experiments.decision: Promote fixed microbiology vocabulary only; traversal remains unresolved.

economics.notes: Panel used 1,820,656 tokens; aborted v1 protocol overhead was 3,546,961 tokens and is reported separately.

experiments.name: A11 V/T/E path-required
experiments.result: T and E recovered terminal evidence on 96/96 answerable cases versus 0/96 for V. E versus T was +0.83pp with 95% CI 0 to +2.56.
experiments.decision: Bounded traversal worked on the constructed multi-hop task. Do not promote event grouping: its single gain is not isolated from the bundled answerability receipt.

economics.notes: Answer arms only; panel added 445,171 tokens. Zero retries.

experiments.name: A11b causal isolation
experiments.population: 64 development Patients + 384 untouched efficacy Patients at run start; one efficacy question per Patient; 1,152 answer slots
experiments.result: Strict normalized artifacts: 288/384 in every arm with paired-difference 97.5% intervals 0.0 to 0.0. Raw insufficiency behavior: 26/96 T0, 96/96 T1, 96/96 E1. Conservative post-hoc sensitivity: 314/384, 384/384, 384/384.
experiments.decision: Preserve the strict artifact but supersede its behavioral null. T1 merits a fresh prospective test; E1 showed no benefit beyond T1. No promotion is licensed; the Patients are spent.

economics.notes: Unregistered answer preview only; all-attempt usage is a lower bound because three pre-inference rejects lacked usable usage. Panel added 1,987,299 tokens.

claim_register.claim: Deterministic question-aware selection beats query-blind projection on this FHIR benchmark.
claim_register.boundary: Supported twice on the 409-question paired corpus, including the repaired time-assumption run. It is not yet a cross-model, cross-server, or natural-chart claim.

claim_register.claim: A fixed microbiology vocabulary improves the selected evidence packet.
claim_register.boundary: Confirmed on the untouched valid-split dispatched stratum with byte-identical negative controls. The claim is terminology- and benchmark-specific.

claim_register.claim: Bounded traversal can recover terminal evidence required by constructed multi-hop FHIR questions.
claim_register.boundary: A11 establishes the mechanism on its synthetic path-required benchmark. It does not establish a native graph database, universal graph superiority, or natural-chart generality.

claim_register.claim: Typed event grouping improves accuracy beyond identical evidence and deterministic aids.
claim_register.boundary: A11 bundled grouping with temporal rank and an answerability receipt. A11b's normalized labels tied, but its forensic amendment found that normalization erased T1/E1's raw insufficiency behavior. E1 still showed no incremental benefit beyond T1. The run cannot license a confirmatory claim, and a fresh discriminating holdout is required.

claim_register.claim: The effect generalizes across model sizes and reasoning levels.
claim_register.boundary: The exploratory grid aggregate used the wrong denominator and is excluded. Cross-API/model generality remains untested.

claim_register.claim: Bonfire should replace its canonical store with a native graph database.
claim_register.boundary: No experiment compared storage engines. Current evidence concerns packet selection, terminology, traversal, and presentation only.

known_gaps: The exploratory model/effort grid must be regraded on its registered 99-question subset before any generality statement.
A6a and QT-1 through QT-3 retained subscription token receipts but not provider-priced monetary cost.
The A11 panel used the same model family as the answerer; a cross-family sensitivity judge remains useful.
The A11b preview completion replay validated prompt, answer, schema, event, usage, and artifact receipts. Its exposure booleans were self-asserted rather than independent measurements.

A11b r3 is not runnable as sealed against the current Codex backend. The successor has a versioned categorical answer contract but still requires a fresh corpus, prospective development discordance, and a new seal.

The 384 A11b efficacy Patients are spent for confirmatory use; a replacement must demonstrate nonzero paired discordance on separate development data before a fresh holdout or cross-API matrix is opened.
No native graph database, Postgres recursive-query, or natural clinical chart comparison has been run.
